designationHistory.name: Francis Marion National Forest Wildlife Preserve
designationHistory.indexText: President Truman established the Francis Marion National Forest Wildlife Preserve as a game sanctuary and refuge in the Francis Marion National Forest, South Carolina.

authority.citation: Proclamation 2785, May 10, 1948, 62 Stat. 1510 (under Public Law 80-257, July 30, 1947, 61 Stat. 516)
